title: UseCaseClassification
description: One record per eligible account (entity primary record). Approved 2026-10-14 with owner changes: Option B (no signal -> none, D26); dispatch notes -> media_captions (D29, revised). Labels are exactly the brief's 8.

evidence_source.description: What the label rests on. 'industry' alone is never used (Option B, D26); kept in the enum only for compatibility.

evidence.description: Verbatim text the label rests on: an exact note from this account and/or its exact industry value. Empty only when evidence_source = no_signal. Checked by script: must be a substring of this account's own data.

rationale.description: One plain-English sentence a rep can read.

needs_review.description: True for ambiguous mappings or low confidence.
